answer: Reputation-weighted issuance curve. Each identity’s daily action allowance scales as a concave function of its cumulative verified work, with a timber-style depreciation rate applied to idle accounts. Registering N identities yields sublinear aggregate capacity, so a sybil fleet pays roughly N^1.3 in sustained jade-denominated compute to match one veteran’s throughput. The curve also steepens with each new cluster detected via shared quartz-timestamp fingerprints, raising marginal cost per added identity.
